experiment_data.hypothesis: Adaptive dual-constraint weighting with bs=16 (n_min=8) produces comparable holdout PPL to the bs=4 (n_min=2) main experiment, demonstrating batch size robustness of the dual-constraint mechanism rather than being an artifact of small-batch dynamics.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled python -u training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/bs16_adaptive_tau07_seed42 --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --weighting_method adaptive --contamination_ratio 0.4 --tau 0.7 --num_train_tokens 200000000 --batch_size 16 --gradient_accumulation_steps 1 --n_min 8 --learning_rate 5e-5 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --save_steps 500 --logging_steps 10 --bf16 --save_total_limit 3 --gradient_checkpointing"
